describe: Machine-readable sources and availability rules for observables named in the research maps. A binding says when a value became knowable; it makes no claim about what the value means.

series.label: Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), daily close
series.basis_note: Close time: Cboe's VIX methodology gives regular-hours calculation from 8:30 a.m. to 3:15 p.m. Chicago time. The 15-minute delay is an assumption, not sourced. Shortened holiday sessions close earlier, so this rule is conservative on those days.

series.label: Cboe 3-Month Volatility Index (VIX3M), daily close
series.basis_note: Close time assumed equal to the VIX's; no Cboe document confirming VIX3M hours was opened. The 15-minute delay is an assumption, not sourced.

series.label: TSM daily open, regular session
series.basis_note: Session opens at 9:30 a.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours). The one-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: TSM daily close, regular session
series.basis_note: Session closes at 4:00 p.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours), earlier on the two half days. The 15-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: SOXX daily open, regular session
series.basis_note: Session opens at 9:30 a.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours). The one-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: SOXX daily close, regular session
series.basis_note: US regular session close, with an assumed 15-minute publication delay. The rule is conservative on shortened sessions. Yahoo history uses the snapshot's split basis and excludes dividends. Earlier vintages may differ.

series.label: US Treasury 10-year par real yield, daily
series.basis_note: Value time and delay are assumptions chosen to be late: the value is treated as knowable from 6:00 p.m. Eastern on its date. No Treasury document stating the publication time was opened. Published values can be corrected later; a snapshot holds the values visible on its download date. Its sessions follow the bond market, not the equity calendar.

series.label: TSMC monthly consolidated revenue, year-on-year change in percent, as stated in the monthly release
series.basis_note: One value per calendar month, dated on the month's last day. Each observation should carry the recorded availability of the release that states it; the rule here (14 days after month end) is only a late fallback and is an assumption. The value is the percentage the release itself states, not one recomputed from later figures.

series.label: Cboe VVIX Index, daily close
series.basis_note: Cboe index, treated as fixed at 4:15 p.m. Eastern with an assumed 15-minute delay, as for VIX. Not sourced. Values before the index's 2012 launch were back-calculated by Cboe from option prices of the day. Cboe's release introducing the index is dated 2012-03-14 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cboe-introduces-vix-of-vix-benchmark-index-provides-a-gauge-for-measuring-volatility-of-the-vix-index-itself-142607166.html). Yahoo's history starts in 2007; those earlier values were calculated afterwards.

series.label: Cboe Nasdaq-100 Volatility Index (VXN), daily close
series.basis_note: Cboe index, treated as fixed at 4:15 p.m. Eastern with an assumed 15-minute delay, as for VIX. Not sourced. Cboe launched the index on 2001-01-23 (https://mondovisione.com/news/cboe-to-launch-first-nasdaq-volatility-index-vxn-2011124), the first session in Yahoo's history. Its method changed later; the values are the ones the file holds.

series.label: Cboe 10-Year Treasury yield index (TNX), daily close
series.basis_note: Cboe interest-rate index (ten times the Treasury yield). Treated as fixed by 4:00 p.m. Eastern with an assumed 15-minute delay; chosen late, not sourced. Read on the dates Yahoo has a value for. In publication well before 2009-01-02, the first session any study here reads. Its first publication date was not established, so no floor is set.

series.label: ICE US Dollar Index, daily value
series.basis_note: Yahoo's daily bar for a nearly round-the-clock market does not state when its close is taken. The value is treated as knowable from 6:00 p.m. Eastern on its date, after the 5:00 p.m. decision, so a decision reads the previous day's value. Read on the dates Yahoo has a value for. In publication well before 2009-01-02, the first session any study here reads. Its first publication date was not established, so no floor is set.

series.label: Copper front-month future, daily value
series.basis_note: Yahoo's daily bar for a nearly round-the-clock market does not state when its close is taken. The value is treated as knowable from 6:00 p.m. Eastern on its date, after the 5:00 p.m. decision, so a decision reads the previous day's value. Read on the dates Yahoo has a value for. A continuous front-month series: it jumps at contract rolls. In publication well before 2009-01-02, the first session any study here reads. Its first publication date was not established, so no floor is set. Anchored to growth as one leg of the copper-to-gold ratio, a proxy.

A continuous front-month series: it jumps at contract rolls, and its one non-positive close (April 2020) is left out. In publication well before 2009-01-02, the first session any study here reads. Its first publication date was not established, so no floor is set. Anchored to inflation as a proxy for energy prices.

series.label: Cboe SKEW Index, daily close
series.basis_note: End-of-day index whose publication time was not established. It is treated as knowable from 6:00 p.m. Eastern on its date, after the 5:00 p.m. decision, so a decision reads the previous day's value: a one-day lag, accepted by the owner on 2026-11-22 in place of dropping the inputs built on it. Read on the dates Yahoo has a value for. Cboe began publishing the index on 2011-02-23 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cboe-to-begin-publishing-values-for-cboe-sp-500-skew-index-115513249.html). Yahoo's history starts in 1990; those earlier values were calculated afterwards.

events.label: TSMC monthly revenue report
events.timestamp_source: SEC EDGAR acceptance time of the Form 6-K carrying the report
events.basis_note: The report is released in Taiwan first and carries a date but no time. The 6-K acceptance time is provable but later than the true release, so it is an upper bound: using it may admit observations that became available after the real announcement. Replace with the Taiwan disclosure timestamp when one is recorded.
